Record Class SecurityPositionSeries.Input

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
grafioschtrader.reportviews.performance.SecurityPositionSeries.Input
Record Components:
idSecuritycurrency - the security
securityName - its name
securityCurrency - its currency
mainCurrency - the main currency of the scope
scopeName - name of the tenant, portfolio or account
margin - whether the security is a margin instrument; its daily values carry only the close and the rate, the value is formed from the open positions of the events
precisionSC - rounding precision of amounts in the currency of the security
precisionMC - rounding precision of amounts in the main currency
events - all events of the scope in ascending date order
phases - all phases from SecurityPositionSeries.phases(List)
phase - the phase to calculate
dailyValues - daily values of the phase
sessions - session days of the security's stock exchange within the phase
today - the client's calendar day
Enclosing class:
SecurityPositionSeries
public static record SecurityPositionSeries.Input(Integer idSecuritycurrency, String securityName, String securityCurrency, String mainCurrency, String scopeName, boolean margin, int precisionSC, int precisionMC, List<SecurityPositionSeries.Event> events, List<SecurityPositionSeriesResult.Phase> phases, SecurityPositionSeriesResult.Phase phase, List<SecurityPositionSeries.DailyValue> dailyValues, Set<LocalDate> sessions, LocalDate today) extends Record
Everything the series of one phase need.
